source: IID full labels over Z_(2^(n+8))^n, m=3n with mod2 or m=5n with mod4, original secret uniform over the full group
noise: Secret-independent mixture of original Z errors with every marginal visibility >=1-1/n; correlations permitted, actual natural-source law not certified
positive_statement: For n>=64, actual fixed-X readout after mod2 at width3n carries >=n/4 residual-secret bits except source probability <2^(-n^2-3n). Mod4 at width5n carries >=n/16 bits except probability <2^(-n^2). Syndrome may be retained or ignored. Parity affine compression preserves the readout information but not independent product phase noise.
proof_dependencies: Full Boolean frequency injectivity implies a uniform average original density and exactly uniform raw X output
Dyadic phase grids retain nonnegative extra harmonics in even cosine moments
A positive finite binary-entropy series with rational inverse-ln2 lower constant bounds raw accessible information
Exact pinching as secret-coset twirl and classical information chain rule charge at most bn coset-label bits for b measured residue bits
matched_baseline: Original raw phase qubits with known S/H product twirl give the same discarded-syndrome z marginal, without a coherent syndrome register; not a classical simulator of unknown-secret data
falsifiers: A full-frequency-injective actual source/readout violates the rational information lower bound
The reduction's noise depends on the secret or violates the required marginal visibility promise
A comparison changes the original/residual secret priors or conflates the full twirl and syndrome instruments
An asserted algorithm depends on uncharged exponential classical likelihood evaluation or on inverting mutual information into a recovery guarantee
unresolved: Efficient computational inference from the actual growing-modulus transcript
Natural problem reduction and its actual source noise
